doc.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Closing thanks and a joke about Hamilton College
summary: Rowe thanks Jerry; they joke about admissions; a pause precedes additional recollections.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you, Monk. I enjoyed talking about these times. They just keep coming back, but I have trouble remembering names.
You remembered mine, I appreciate it.

Yeah, I have to make a point of it. I looked at your card, I looked at it again, I looked at it again, then I make a mental picture. Like you said to be up here at 10:30 and the room is 1031, and I says hey it follows the time. I need a little hook. But I enjoyed it.
Just like music, we need the hook. Well on behalf of Hamilton College, I’d like to thank you very much and I hope the rest of the weekend here is good for you.
Thank you, and I’ll tell you, if any of my grandchildren try to get into Hamilton College, will you help me?
I’ll put in a good word.
You turned down one of my sons already.
I’m glad we got that on tape. Is it too late for him to come back? We’ll keep it in mind.
Jerry returns with a few additional recollections.
